revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, looking into a large indoor public area with open sightlines, varied furniture, realistic foot-traffic cues, industrial vinyl flooring, and warm practical interior lighting. Off-axis corridor view at closer inspection distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. In the scene, a clearly visible older adult woman with a small build wears a beige coat, purple and gray casual clothing, and comfortable shoes; she is repairing something while in a one-knee kneel, with hips and legs supporting the posture and shoulders held above the ground. Include a few tools and boxes placed naturally in the background. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, no cinematic or advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
